notes.title: Update 0.1.5
notes.content:
🔹 UI has been completely redone. (It's a lot prettier now)
🔹 A couple more options are available in the Audio/Visuals settings menu.
🔹 Holding objects is way more enjoyable. (You won't accidentally drop it unless you're doing it on purpose)
🔹 Cheesing Test #5 has finally been fixed
🔹 Added projectile impact decals. (You can now make drawings on walls)

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
- Added a proper "early access completed" message.
- Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1
notes.content:
- Added a Shader Compilation when launching the game.
- Fixed the bug where if the Astro Link portal was near a window, it was impossible or nearly impossible to teleport with it.
- Fixed the softlock in level 8 where you could get stuck between some fans and a door.
- Fixed the bug where the "landing on ground" sound would trigger every frame when holding jump while crouched.
